lines.text: JESSIE: Stop right there!\nWe’ll be going first!
JAMES: With that specter out of the way, we can\nfinally get to the top!
JESSIE: You’re the old geezer they call\nMr. Fuji, right?
You’re going to be repeating your Pokémon\nresearch for the glory of Team Rocket!
JAMES: Ignore us all you like—we’re used to it!\nWe won’t take no for an answer.\r\nYou’ll help the boss, whether you want to or not!
JESSIE: Gramps here thinks he can resist,\nso we’re setting him straight!
JAMES: You’d better disappear, twerp,\nor be prepared to fight!
JAMES: Looks like Operation Stealthily Kidnap\nFuji is a bust, then...
JESSIE: Don’t you think I know that?\nIt’ll be fine—we just have to help out with\r\nthe [VAR COLOR(0006)]take-over of Silph Co.[VAR COLOR(0000)] in [VAR COLOR(0006)]Saffron City[VAR COLOR(0000)].
JESSIE & JAMES: Looks like Team Rocket’s\nblasting off again!

JESSIE: Hey, twerp, you can’t battle the both of
us with just one Pokémon!\c
You’d better go get another and come back to
take us on!
